meta.tldr:
Aider 0.86.0 brings comprehensive updates to model support and command usability. All GPT-5 models are now supported, expanding the range of advanced AI capabilities available. Grok-4 can now be accessed via `xai/grok-4` and `openrouter/x-ai/grok-4`, and the `gemini/gemini-2.5-flash-lite-preview-06-17` model has been added, along with `openrouter/moonshotai/kimi-k2`, significantly broadening the choice of LLMs for developers.

Command improvements enhance user feedback and readability. The `/clear` command now explicitly prints "All chat history cleared." to confirm its execution, providing immediate visual feedback. The `/undo` command's output has been streamlined to show only the first line of each commit message, making it much easier to review changes. Additionally, the `/model` command, when called without arguments, now displays model announcements, keeping users informed about new or updated models.

Important fixes include resolving an issue where new settings for existing models failed to overwrite old ones, ensuring model configurations are correctly applied. Analytics have been updated to support the latest PostHog SDK event-capture API, improving data collection reliability. Dependency bumps, specifically to `litellm==1.75.0`, ensure compatibility and leverage the latest upstream improvements. This release is a recommended upgrade for all users to benefit from expanded model access, improved command-line experience, and critical bug fixes.
